title: Every-night jobs and band sizes
summary: Bands worked every night, usually five pieces, sometimes three, with piano, drums, clarinet, trumpet, trombone, guitar or violin.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Well, would they have a every night a week job, or would it be three nights a week, or what?
They'd be jumping every night in the house.
And you say they used mostly five pieces? Mostly five pieces, yeah.
Give me that. What would they have in the band?

What instruments? Well, I would have the cabra piano, and carolets, trumpets, trombone. Some would have this bass guitar and violin. Some would just have maybe this piano drumming, clarolets. Or maybe trumpet. You know what I'm saying? Three piece. Some would have this piano.
